# OpenCode Remote Access

> MIT-licensed GUI plugin for managing authenticated remote access from OpenCode Desktop settings.

The gateway exposes the native OpenCode Web interface over HTTP or HTTPS with configurable credentials, one-time pairing, IP allowlists, device aliases, and sign-in logs. OpenCode Desktop v2.3.0 was verified on macOS.
